title: Migration decisions
description: What `link-loom migrate apply` builds the new project from. `migrate analyze <repo>` writes a draft of it (migration.decisions.json); a person or an agent finishes it. The legacy repo is only read.

source.description: Absolute folder of the legacy app (written by analyze; leave it)

project.description: The options of `create webapp` for the new project (npx link-loom schema webapp): name, slug, variant (client|admin), description and descriptionEs (written natively in Spanish), defaultLocale, signup, stoneos, commandCenter, primaryColor, headerColor…

name.description: Product name, as people read it (e.g. "ÊTRUNE ID")

routes.description: The legacy routes and the page file each renders (written by analyze). A page decided `move` is mounted on its paths, relative to the app's base route.

entities.description: Lists and records rebuilt with the kit: each item is the input of `add entity` (npx link-loom schema entity). Decide their legacy list, record and form files `discard`. When a sidebar row below opens the entity's list (/<domain>/<plural>), that row keeps its place and the entity adds no row of its own.

files.description: Every source file of the legacy app, carried over (`move`) or left behind (`discard`). A moved file lands where `link-loom check` expects it, from its kind, domain, entity, role and name; a name that would land on a file of the new project must change, or the file be discarded.

reason.description: Why it is discarded (for the report)

kind.description: page → src/pages/<domain>/<Domain><Name>.page.jsx; service → src/services/<domain>/<entity>/<domain>-<entity>.service.js (base: true → src/services/base/); hook → src/hooks/; constants → src/constants/<name>.constants.js (name theme merges into the palette); component → by role

role.description: For components: list|record|quick-actions → src/components/pages/<domain>/<entity>/<role>/; shared → src/components/shared/<name>/; component → src/components/pages/<domain>/<name>/; utils → src/utils/

entity.description: Entity in kebab-case, for services and list/record components

name.description: The file's new name (PascalCase for pages and components)

navigation.description: The sidebar rows, in order; each becomes `add nav-item` (npx link-loom schema nav-item). analyze reads them from the legacy sidebar with their icon, section title and group.

icon.description: A key of the icon catalog (npx link-loom schema nav-item); empty for the default

before.description: Id of the row this one goes before (default: Advanced settings)

sectionEn.description: Section title printed above the row or its group

group.description: Id of the group (a collapsible title with links) this row belongs to

texts.description: Every text the carried code writes for people: JSX text and literals, text attributes, labels of object literals (columns, tabs, tiles) and notices. Each needs its key, English and Spanish to move into src/i18n; a text without them stays written in the code. Two texts may share a key only with the same words.

start.description: Offset of the text in the legacy file (written by analyze; leave it)

text.description: The text as the legacy code writes it

links.description: Legacy app paths written in the code → their place in the new project (e.g. "/admin/account/overview": "/admin/account/profile"). A key rewrites that path (with its ?query or #hash); a key ending in "/" rewrites every path under it ("/admin/item/": "/admin/items/"). `migrate finish` lists the links that still lead nowhere in MIGRATION.md.

assets.description: Public files the code uses; `keep: false` leaves one behind
